about_desc_1: Al Hemish Contracting & Supplies is a Saudi company specialized in executing integrated projects with high quality and professionalism.
about_desc_2: We specialize in construction works, finishing, electrical and mechanical works, communication systems, low-current systems, safety and security systems, smart control systems, smart homes, renewable energy solutions, and technical supplies.
about_desc_3: We are committed to providing advanced engineering solutions that combine high quality with technical innovation.
mission_desc: To deliver integrated contracting solutions based on quality and innovation, supported by strong technical and engineering expertise to achieve customer satisfaction and contribute to the development of infrastructure across the Kingdom.
vision_desc: To be one of the leading national companies in the contracting sector in Saudi Arabia, providing integrated and innovative solutions that meet client needs and contribute to the development of infrastructure and urban environments.
goals_desc: We strive to provide integrated engineering solutions that combine quality and innovation, positioning ourselves as a trusted partner in supporting Saudi Vision 2030 and contributing to building a prosperous and sustainable future.
values_desc: Our values are the foundation of every decision we make — guiding us to deliver excellence on every project we undertake.
strategic_objectives_desc: Our strategic goals are designed to position Al Hemish as the leading contracting company in Saudi Arabia, aligned with Vision 2030.
objective_1_desc: Deliver every project on schedule with the highest standards.
objective_2_desc: Invest in training and empowering Saudi professionals.
objective_3_desc: Build lasting relationships with clients and partners.
objective_4_desc: Grow our footprint across all regions of Saudi Arabia.
objective_5_desc: Stay ahead by embracing the latest innovations in contracting.
const_des_1: Full construction from excavation and foundations to concrete structure and interior/exterior finishes including paints, flooring, ceilings, and facades. We deliver complete building solutions with a strong focus on quality, safety, and precision at every stage of the project.
const_des_2: Our experienced engineers and skilled professionals use modern construction techniques and high-quality materials to ensure every project is durable, functional, and built to the highest industry standards. We carefully manage each phase to achieve timely completion while maintaining exceptional craftsmanship.
const_des_3: Whether you are planning a residential, commercial, or industrial project, we provide customized construction and finishing solutions tailored to your vision and budget. Our commitment to customer satisfaction, transparent communication, and attention to detail ensures results that exceed expectations and stand the test of time.

electrical_des_1: We provide comprehensive electrical solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Our services include power distribution systems, wiring, lighting installations, control panels, and electrical infrastructure designed to ensure efficiency, safety, and long-term reliability.
electrical_des_2: Our team of qualified electrical engineers and technicians follows international standards and best practices to deliver high-quality installations and maintenance services. We utilize advanced equipment and modern technologies to guarantee optimal performance and energy efficiency.
mechanical_des_1: We provide comprehensive mechanical solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Our services include HVAC systems, plumbing networks, firefighting systems, pumps, piping installations, and mechanical infrastructure designed for efficiency, reliability, and long-term performance.
mechanical_des_2: Our experienced mechanical engineers and technicians apply industry best practices and advanced technologies to ensure every system is installed and operated according to the highest quality and safety standards. We focus on delivering energy-efficient and cost-effective solutions tailored to project requirements.
safety_des_1: We provide comprehensive safety and security solutions designed to protect people, assets, and facilities. Our services include fire alarm systems, firefighting networks, emergency lighting, evacuation systems, and integrated safety infrastructure that meets international standards.
safety_des_2: Our experts design and implement advanced security systems including CCTV surveillance, access control systems, intrusion detection, and monitoring solutions. Every system is carefully planned to ensure maximum protection, reliability, and operational efficiency.
communication_des_1: We provide advanced communication and low-current solutions that support modern buildings and smart infrastructure. Our services include structured cabling systems, data networks, fiber optic installations, and communication infrastructure designed for reliability and scalability.
communication_des_2: Our expertise covers data centers, public address systems, audio and video distribution, intercom systems, and integrated communication platforms. We ensure seamless connectivity and high-performance operation across residential, commercial, and industrial facilities.
smart_des_1: We provide intelligent building automation and control solutions that enhance comfort, efficiency, and operational performance. Our systems enable centralized monitoring and control of lighting, HVAC, shading systems, energy consumption, and other critical building functions.
smart_des_2: Our expertise includes KNX, DALI, and Building Management Systems (BMS) integration, allowing seamless communication between mechanical, electrical, and security systems. This ensures optimized building performance, reduced energy consumption, and improved user experience.
renewable_des_1: We provide innovative renewable energy solutions that help organizations and individuals reduce energy costs, improve sustainability, and minimize environmental impact. Our services include solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, energy storage solutions, and advanced power management technologies.
renewable_des_2: Our team designs and installs high-performance solar energy systems, smart battery storage solutions, and electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure tailored to the unique requirements of each project. We focus on maximizing energy efficiency, reliability, and long-term value.
technical_des_1: We supply a wide range of high-quality technical products, equipment, and materials to support construction, industrial, commercial, and infrastructure projects. Our extensive supplier network allows us to deliver reliable solutions that meet international standards and project specifications.
technical_des_2: Our offerings include electrical components, mechanical equipment, low-current systems, safety products, automation devices, and specialized technical materials sourced from trusted manufacturers and leading global brands.
